description.zh:
关联资源标签规则的设置名称。

具体取值，请参见[支持关联资源标签设置功能的资源](~~2586330~~)中的**规则设置名称**列。
description.en:
The name of the Associated Resource Tag Rule setting.

For valid values, see the **Setting Name** column in [Resources that support the Associated Resource Tag Rule feature](~~2586330~~).

description.zh:
是否开启关联资源标签规则。取值：

- Enable：开启。
- Disable：关闭。
description.en:
The status of the Associated Resource Tag Rule. Valid values:

- Enable: The rule is enabled.

- Disable: The rule is disabled.

description.zh: 关联资源标签规则作用的标签键列表。
description.en: A list of tag keys for the Associated Resource Tag Rule.

title.zh: 更新关联资源标签规则

example.unifiedCli: aliyun tag update-associated-resource-rule --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --setting-name rule:AssociateEip-UnassociateEip-TagInstance:Ecs-Instance:Vpc-Eip --tag-keys k1 --status Enable --existing-status example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun tag UpdateAssociatedResourceRule --region cn-hangzhou --Status Enable --SettingName 'rule:AssociateEip-UnassociateEip-TagInstance:Ecs-Instance:Vpc-Eip' --ExistingStatus 'example-string' --TagKeys.1 k1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
